title: Masala Poori
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

    boiled peas

    onion

    tomato

    ginger garlic pasta

    potato

    coriander leaves

    green chilli

    poori

    coriander powder

    cumin powder

    garam masala

    date chutney

    coriander chutney

    salt

    chaat masala

    How to prepare:
    In a pan add some oil and add onion, tomatoes, ginger garlic paste and fry until tomatoes get smooth. 
    after few seconds of frying add turmeric powder, chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, add coriander leaves keep them aside 
    after it cools down add this into mixi and grind it into smooth paste. In another pan add some oil add cumin seeds 
    add some onion and add ground paste and fry for 2 minutes and add boiled peas and potatoes and boil 2 mins 
    now add 1 teaspoon garam masala and now add some water and adjust consistency add some salt and lemon juice.
    serving preparation:
    In a plate scramble some pooris then add some curry we prepared then add some tomatoes, onion and green chutney, date chutney,
    chaat masala powder shave and decorate with coriander leaves and serve.
